Post-ransomware litigation ongoing. Shield + GRC + Compliance Modules connected unlock: (3.40) is TCB's strongest category — Shield builds on existing compliance strength. items.why_text: The assessment found: “CFPB Consumer Complaint Database excludes complaints about depository institutions with <$10B in assets — TCB at $9.87B is below threshold. Complaints referred to FDIC, not published. Cannot assess” [E-053]. P1.findings_md:
TCB's position relative to peers by pillar reveals a consistent pattern: compliance-strong, digitally-developing.
TCB ranks 5th or 6th in customer-facing pillars (P1, P2) but 4th in operational and technology pillars (P3, P4) — reflecting a bank that has invested in compliance and security infrastructure but not yet in digital customer experience or data architecture. The deposit growth imperative [E-091] makes the P2 weakness particularly urgent: TCB cannot defend deposits against digitally-advanced competitors while ranking last in customer experience.
